verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's developer portal and AI Hub provide SDKs and toolchains for AI/NPU workloads (Qualcomm AI Engine Direct SDK, AI Hub, GenieX) targeting Windows on Snapdragon, showing some developer tooling investment, but there is no evidence of general-purpose compiler maturity, official CPU optimization guides beyond AI, or independent confirmation that Windows-on-Arm/Snapdragon is treated as a tier-one target by the broader OS/toolchain ecosystem (e.g., LLVM/MSVC parity, native app compatibility). Community discussion focuses on missing benchmarks and TDP data, not on dev-ecosystem maturity. Missing for 10: evidence of general compiler/toolchain parity with x86, first-party OS vendor (Microsoft) tier-one commitment, and independent developer reports of a mature non-AI dev experience.
